newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's bourse ends little changed.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's bourse ends little changed.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange ended its two-hour session on Monday little changed despite substantial gains made by some blue-chip firms, a market analyst said.
The all-share index closed at 598.64 points against 598.70 points on Friday, he said.
"The bourse index remained nearly unchanged despite gains made by largest market capitalisation such as ONA Group and BMCE bank," a broker at Upline Securities said.
But the market is expected to resume its upward trend soon, he added.
ONA Group, Morocco's largest private conglomerate, rose 10 dirhams to 760 dirhams. The group is expected to show up to 800 million dirhams net profits for its 1996 activities, the broker said.
Its subsidiary Financiere Diwan rose nine dirhams to close at 330 dirhams.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, one of the market blue chips, closed at 562 dirhams, up two dirhams on the previous session.

In its recent audited results, BMCE showed a net profit of 366 million dirhams ($38.9 million) in 1996, up 21 percent on the previous year. The bank has a market capitalisation of 8.08 billion dirhams.
The bourse total transactions in value reached 101.1 million dirhams, of which 76.6 million were on the official market, against 60.2 million dirhams on Friday, a bourse official said.
The number of shares that changed hands on Monday rose to 88,166 against 62,797 shares on Friday, he added.
